note: Missouri Department of Conservation floodplain area of bottomland forest, wetlands and old fields on the Missouri River north of Marion, with six miles of river frontage reached by mowed paths and levees closed to vehicles. MDC's map marks one primitive camping area on open grass beside the entrance parking lot, just east of the railroad crossing on Moniteau Creek Road; no defined sites or amenities. The area has no flood protection: the road can close when the river floods or the surface is impassable, and there is only one way in and out. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: map-designated primitive camping area beside the entrance lot (brochure: designated areas shown on map, may lack defined sites). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin moves ~200 m from a mowed strip west of the railroad onto the open ground beside the lot that the map marks. Phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK (lot-side designated area): area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites; Boat-in along Missouri River'; brochure 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites. No amenities are provided.' The map's single 'Primitive Camping Area' symbol is drawn directly south of the entrance 'Parking Lot' on the area road, east of the railroad. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101. Kept under the designated-point rule.

PIN (move ~200 m): stored 38.72392,-92.39734 = GIS 27 point 281, which imagery puts in a mowed grass strip ~35 m off the gravel road WEST of the railroad, with no pad or drive; the map draws the camping symbol beside the parking lot EAST of the crossing (GIS 26 lot 2114, 38.72425,-92.39513). Imagery there shows a gravel lot with a shelter building and an open mowed area to its south with a vehicle parked on it. Move to 38.7239,-92.3951 (open ground just south of the lot). GIS 281 looks misplaced.

ACCESS caveat (in the note): brochure 'Marion Bottoms is unusual in that it has no flood protection'; 'The entire road or portions of the road may be temporarily or permanently closed if road conditions are impassable due to rainfall, river flood events, poor road surface'; page 'There is currently only one way in and out of the area.' The brochure's 'Open May 15-September 15, daylight hours only' applies to the EWRP field roads, not the area road to the lot.
BOAT-IN: brochure 'Camping is allowed by Missouri River boat travelers within 100 yards of the river between April 1 and September 30' - boat-in only, not part of this entry.
HORSES: none mentioned. CLUSTERS: one camping area; Marion Access (13890, own entry) ~4.5 km SE; Hartsburg Access across the river. No split.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept (the river is ~1.5 km east across the bottoms).
Season (year-round, manual) left: brochure 'Camping is allowed anytime'.
